rule.labels: A region votes only if all Qwen source labels are movable or all are fixed; mixed, uncertain, absent labels abstain. Independent pure regions union; fixed wins overlaps.
rule.independence: At most one vote of each class per spatial cell per scan; epochs for each class at least 0.5 s apart. Camera bits from accepted epochs only. Same-scan cameras/beams never create extra epochs.
rule.construction: Offline two-pass: collect complete lt_changes_0 evidence, then omit every ray whose endpoint is in a confirmed movable cell without fixed evidence. Other old per-ray removals are not retained automatically.
